record.paper_title: Supernomial Coefficients, Bailey's Lemma and Rogers-Ramanujan-Type Identities. A Survey of Results and Open Problems
record.original_question: Prove the proposed level-N A_{n-1} string-function generalization of the weak Bailey summation. More explicitly, for n>=2, N>=1, k in Z^n with |k|=0, normalized A_{n-1} supernomials S(L,k), and the level-N A_{n-1} string function C_k(q) represented by a sum over eta in Z^{n-1} tensor Z^{N-1}, show that the double sum over L in Z_+^{n-1} and eta with exponent (L C L)/(2N) + eta(C tensor C^{-1})eta/2 and q-binomial factor [(mu+eta) choose eta]_q equals q^((k1^2+...+kn^2)/(2N)) C_k(q). The variables eta and mu must obey the source's integrality constraints, including that mu is fixed by (C tensor I)eta + (I tensor C)mu = C L tensor e_{N-1}. The case n=2 is known; the open goal is the general case.

evidence.quote: natural to ask for a generalization
A proof of conjecture 6.3 for n = 2

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\geq 2$ and $N\geq 1$ be integers. Let $C=(C_{ij})_{1\leq i,j\leq n-1}$ be the Cartan matrix of type $A_{n-1}$, i.e. $C_{ii}=2$, $C_{i,i\pm 1}=-1$, and $C_{ij}=0$ otherwise. For $k=(k_1,\dots,k_n)\in\mathbb Z^n$ with $|k|=k_1+\cdots+k_n=0$, define:

(i) the normalized $A_{n-1}$ supernomial $S(L,k)\in\mathbb Z[q]$ associated with a composition $L\in\mathbb Z_+^{n-1}$ and the weight encoded by $k$ (the standard $q$-supernomial coefficient of type $A_{n-1}$);

(ii) the level-$N$ $A_{n-1}$ string function $C_k(q)$, expressed via a sum
$$C_k(q)=\sum_{\eta\in\mathbb Z^{n-1}\otimes\mathbb Z^{N-1}} (\text{standard summand})\,,$$
which is the normalized branching/string function of the level-$N$ vacuum module of $\widehat{\mathfrak{sl}}_n$ at weight $k$.

For $L\in\mathbb Z_+^{n-1}$ and $\eta\in\mathbb Z^{n-1}\otimes\mathbb Z^{N-1}$, let $\mu\in\mathbb Z^{n-1}\otimes\mathbb Z^{N-1}$ be determined by the linear constraint
$$(C\otimes I)\eta + (I\otimes C)\mu = (CL)\otimes e_{N-1},$$
where $e_{N-1}$ is the last standard basis vector in $\mathbb Z^{N-1}$, with the integrality requirements that make $\mu$ a well-defined nonnegative integer vector.

Define the $q$-binomial coefficient $\binom{a+b}{b}_q$ in the usual way. Prove that
$$\sum_{L\in\mathbb Z_+^{n-1}}\sum_{\eta} q^{\tfrac{1}{2N}\,L^{T}CL+\tfrac{1}{2}\eta^{T}(C\otimes C^{-1})\eta}\binom{\mu+\eta}{\eta}_q S(L,k) \;=\; q^{(k_1^2+\cdots+k_n^2)/(2N)}\,C_k(q).$$

The case $n=2$ is established; prove the identity for all $n\geq 2$.
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches surface the survey and related work on $A_{n-1}$ supernomials, Bailey's lemma, string functions, and cylindric partitions, but no source confirms a full proof of the level-$N$ $A_{n-1}$ weak Bailey summation conjecture for general $n$. The $n=2$ case is known; the general case appears to remain a conjecture, but no definitive resolution (positive or negative) was found.
